subject: PromptForge tracer SDK — sandbox POC & LangChain/LlamaIndex compatibility
messages:
From: Timothy Green <tim.green@promptforge.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PromptForge tracer SDK — sandbox POC & LangChain/LlamaIndex compatibility

Hey Rachel,

Thanks for the quick intro last week at the partner meetup. PromptForge builds a tracing and observability SDK (Tracer) for LLM ecosystems; we've recently added LangChain and LlamaIndex helpers and would like to run a short sandbox POC against Redwood’s hosted runtime to validate end-to-end trace capture, token-level timing, and a minimal-cost telemetry export.

High-level asks:
- Quick sandbox against a Redwood dev environment (3–4 days) to exercise the LangChain/LlamaIndex bindings.
- A short mutual action plan (attached) and a SOW draft (attached) we can iterate on.
- A 30-min demo next week to walk product+engineering through the integration surface.

Attachments: PromptForge_Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf, SOW_v0.1.docx

Why we think this is a fit: our tracer captures prefix/KV cache events and per-token latencies; combined with Redwood’s batching/caching it will help customers debug cost/latency regressions. We also have a small sample repo that shows LangChain + Redwood API calls.

Proposed next step: quick discovery call + agree on security questions we need to fill.

Thanks,
Timothy Green
Head of Integrations, PromptForge
https://promptforge.ai

Hi Timothy — welcome, and thanks for the materials. Quick note from Partnerships on process and timeline:

1) Onboarding checklist attached (ISV_onboarding_checklist.xlsx). Please complete sections: "Sandbox access requirements", "Expected telemetry endpoints", and "Data retention & PII considerations".
2) Security questionnaire: we require either an SOC2 report or completion of our questionnaire; I've attached the questionnaire template. If SOC2 isn't available, return the questionnaire and we'll treat it as an interim control.
3) Commercial basics: we'll track a pilot deal (PF-2027-045). HubSpot link included below. Marissa will own contracting, Rachel will own engineering coordination.

We typically run a 1-week sandbox: day 0–1 config and smoke tests, day 2–4 validation with sample prompts and traces, day 5 deliverables (trace exercise report + next steps).

Can you return the security questionnaire and a short compatibility matrix by EOD Friday? If so, we'll schedule the sandbox for the following week.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: PromptForge tracer SDK — sandbox POC & LangChain/LlamaIndex compatibility

Team,

Thanks — attaching our answers as a filled PDF (Security_Questionnaire_filled.pdf) and a short SOW redline (SOW_Redlines_v1.pdf). Quick summaries:
- Compatibility matrix: LangChain connectors (v0.32+), LlamaIndex nodes (v1.7+); for some opt-in helpers we need to instrument callbacks that Redwood exposes (we've listed the endpoints in the matrix).
- Telemetry model: by default we stream minimal telemetry (token timings, prefix cache hits, request id) to our secure ingest; for POCs we can configure export to your observability endpoint (TLS + token auth).
- Expected load: pilot will be under 50 RPS sustained, with occasional spikes to 150 RPS during stress tests.

Repo/demo links: https://github.com/promptforge/tracer-redwood-sample (contains LangChain example and a LlamaIndex notebook).

We'll take the demo any time next week — Tue/Wed mornings PT preferred.

Best,
Timothy

Hi Timothy — quick technical items before the sandbox: 

1) Can you confirm whether your tracer relies on any KV-cache observable hooks (we have both prefix caching and per-session KV caches)? If it needs real-time KV visibility we may need to add a short runtime flag.
2) For quantized model variants we sometimes have different kernel behavior; will your tracer's timing remain accurate across 4-bit quantized variants?
3) For the export: we prefer telemetry to come to a dedicated ingest endpoint in our sandbox network; can you support token-based auth with a short-lived credential?

If you file a Jira (RW-INF-1283) with a short checklist we can track tasks. Proposed demo slot: Thu 2027-04-14 11:00 PT — 30 minutes. Please include a short runbook for sample prompts you want us to replay.

Sample command we expect to run in the sandbox:
$ python run_replay.py --model rwd/v1-llama-16q --prompts sample_prompts.json --trace-output trace.ndjson

If you can hit those questions and the Jira by EOD Monday we'll be able to schedule the sandbox for the week after.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Product Manager, Serving Runtime
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
